entities.name: Nymris
entities.description: A faerie knight of Lorwyn who leads a clique of faeries, fiercely loyal to Queen Oona.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Plane where Nymris leads his clique.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Queen of the faeries to whom Nymris delivers harvested dreams.

entities.name: Nymris's clique
entities.description: A clique of faeries on Lorwyn led by Nymris that harvests dreams for Oona.

events.summary: Nymris accepts the mission to irritate and exhaust humanoids so they sleep deeply and yield potent dreams.
events.quote: It is his responsibility to irritate and exhaust any humanoid he comes across.

relations.note: He is fiercely loyal to Queen Oona.
He leads a clique of faeries.
relations.quote: Nymris leads a clique of faeries on the plane of Lorwyn.
